info.name: Tiffin Service API v1
info.description:
Complete & up-to-date REST API Collection for the Tiffin Service Backend.

**Base URL variable:** `{{base_url}}` = http://localhost:8888/api/v1

**Auth tokens are auto-saved** by the Login scripts into:
- `{{customer_token}}` — set after customer login
- `{{restaurant_token}}` — set after restaurant login

Generated from source code on 2026-08-25.

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: Public and protected auth endpoints. Login scripts auto-save tokens.

request.description: Register a new user. Role can be CUSTOMER or RESTAURANT.
Login as a CUSTOMER. Token is automatically saved to {{customer_token}}.
Login as a RESTAURANT owner. Token is automatically saved to {{restaurant_token}}.
Returns the currently authenticated user's profile.
Invalidates the current Sanctum token. Optionally pass fcm_token to deregister the device.

item.name: 🍽️ Customer — Restaurants & Menu
item.description: Restaurant discovery and menu browsing. Role: CUSTOMER.

item.name: 🗓️ Customer — Daily Meals
item.description: View today's, tomorrow's, weekly and date-based meals. Role: CUSTOMER.

request.description: Returns today's scheduled meal with addons. Falls back to any meal scheduled for today if no explicit TODAY type found.

item.name: 🛒 Customer — Cart
item.description: Cart management. Items must belong to a single restaurant. Role: CUSTOMER.

request.description: Returns all cart items with subtotal and restaurant_id.
Provide either menu_item_id OR addon_id (not both). Items from different restaurants will be rejected.

item.name: 📦 Customer — Orders
item.description: Order placement, listing, details, cancellation & real-time tracking. Role: CUSTOMER.

request.description: Creates an order. Proceed to Worldpay payment simulation after this step.

query.description: active | PENDING | CONFIRMED | PREPARING | READY | COMPLETED | CANCELLED

request.description: Returns full order with items, address, restaurant and payments.
Only allowed when order_status is PENDING or CONFIRMED. Kitchen-started orders cannot be cancelled.
Returns a 6-step timeline: PAID → CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY → OUT_FOR_DELIVERY → DELIVERED.

item.name: 📍 Customer — Addresses
item.description: CRUD for customer delivery addresses. Role: CUSTOMER.

request.description: First address is auto-set as default. Setting is_default=true unsets all other defaults.
Deleting the default address automatically promotes the next available address.

item.name: 🔔 Customer — Subscriptions
item.description: Meal plan subscription management. Role: CUSTOMER.

item.name: 🏪 Restaurant — Profile
item.description: Restaurant profile management via API. Role: RESTAURANT + restaurant.isolation.

item.name: 🚀 Restaurant — Order Management
item.description: Real-time order management and status progression. Role: RESTAURANT.

query.description: Order number, customer name or phone

request.description: Transitions order to CONFIRMED status.
Transitions order to PREPARING status. Customer receives a push notification.
Transitions order to READY status.
Sets delivery_status to OUT_FOR_DELIVERY and generates a delivery OTP. OTP is returned in the success message.
Sets delivery_status to DELIVERED. delivery_otp is optional but recommended for verification.
reason is required. Triggers CANCELLED status and customer notification.

item.name: 💳 Payments — Worldpay
item.description: Worldpay webhook, simulation (dev/sandbox only) and refunds.

request.description: Public endpoint — called by Worldpay after a transaction. No auth required.
⚠️ DEV/SANDBOX ONLY. Simulates a Worldpay PAID or FAILED webhook for a given order_number. Moves the order from PENDING to PAID status.
Available to SUPER_ADMIN or the RESTAURANT owner of the specific order. Both restaurant_token and a super-admin token are valid here.

item.name: 🔔 Notifications & FCM Devices
item.description: Push notification inbox and FCM device token management. Available to both CUSTOMER and RESTAURANT roles.

request.description:
Register FCM token for push notifications. device_type: android | ios | web | unknown.
Also available at: POST /devices/register and POST /device/fcm-token
Alias for POST /notifications/token.
Deactivates the FCM token (e.g., on logout or device switch). Does not delete the record.
Paginated list of notifications for the authenticated user, newest first.
Returns { unread_count: N }.
